The '''Kiffex system''', also known as the '''Azurbani system''',<ref name="Wizards" /> was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] containing the twin [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]] and [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]].
